messages:
maria: uploaded a draft Grafana panel for GPU regional health + a proposed health-scoring formula. asking for quick review before i wire it into alerts. dashboard UID: gpu-regional-health. link: https://grafana.internal/d/gpu-regional-health
shawn: skimmed — looks promising. does the score include Xid and ECC rates normalized by GPU-hours?
lee: can you paste the promql you're using for Xid uncorrectable? want to sanity-check the spike detection window.
maria: sure — here's the core queries i'm testing:
```
# per-gpu Xid uncorrectable count over 1h window
sum(increase(nvidia_gpu_xid_errors_total{type="uncorrectable"}[1h])) by (gpu_id, zone)

# correctable ECC rate per hour normalized by memory size
(sum(increase(nvidia_gpu_ecc_correctable_total[1h])) by (gpu_id) / on_instance_gpu_memory_bytes)
```
harper: nice. suggest also add `nvidia_smi_temperature_celsius` and `gpu_power_watts` spikes — some flaky cards show thermal cycling without ECC first.
shawn: agree. we should weight signals by severity: uncorrectable ECC/Xid = 5x, repeated driver resets = 3x, correctable ECC = 1x. then compute a rolling score over 6h median. if score > threshold -> node flagged.
ben: what's the threshold? and how do we avoid false positives in regions with older fleet? we can't OOS entire region for noisy telemetry.
maria: draft thresholds: score >= 100 => auto-drain candidate; 50-100 => pre-emptive alert to oncall; <50 => monitor. score components are integers so these map to concrete event counts. i'll add region-adjustment factor (age_factor) to scale thresholds: age_factor = min(2, 1 + fleet_age_months/24).
oncall-sre: auto-drain candidate needs gating: confirm GPU processes movable, check pod disruption budgets, and attempt live-migrate/reschedule before drain. we need a playbook snippet in the alert message.
lee: playbook (one-liner style) i propose in the alert: 1) `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node>` 2) annotate pods that must not be evicted 3) `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` 4) monitor job failures for 15min 5) escalate to hw-ops if Xid_uc > 5 in 24h
maria: adding the exact commands in the runbook:```
# check gpu errors on node
journalctl -u nvidia-driver -o cat | grep -i xid | tail -n 200
# safe drain
kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=120
# quick health repro (synthetic workload to exercise mem/copy)
SYNTH_CMD="./tools/gpu-smoke --duration=60 --mem-stress"
```
harper: for alerts, include runbook link + last 24h time series thumbnails for: Xid_uc, ECC_correctable, driver_resets, temp_p95, pci_errors. makes triage faster in PagerDuty.
ben: SLO conversation — what do we promise to customers per region? ops prefers regional GPU reliability SLO = 99.9% per month (per GPU-nodes eligible) with 4h error budget. alternative is a capacity-weighted SLO (95% of capacity must be healthy).
shawn: capacity-weighted SLO is more meaningful to product. e.g., regional SLO = percent of total reserved GPU-hours available. then burnt budget is hours lost due to auto-drain/uncaught failures.
oncall-sre: also add a quiet-window for scheduled maintenance; don't count planned replacements against SLO. need annotation flow to mark a replacement as planned.
maria: i've mocked up two Grafana panels: 1) per-region aggregated health score heatmap, 2) per-cluster capacity-available gauge (capacity hours available / capacity hours expected). alerts mapped to both absolute (node flagged) and aggregate (region capacity dip).
lee: small nit: make alerts use `for: 10m` so transient single spikes don't auto-trigger drain scripts. set an escalation to `for: 1h` before paging infra-leads.
ben: cost note — replacing cards proactively vs running with 5% capacity loss in a region. we should compute cost of swap (parts+tech time ~ $1.2k) vs expected revenue loss per GPU-hour. can we add a metric to estimate replacement ROI?
harper: yep — we can surface a simple `estimated_cost_of_degradation = lost_gpu_hours * revenue_per_gpu_hour` on the dashboard for ops-view. will help make replace decisions.
maria: action items: 1) i'll update queries to include temp/power/pci errors and add age_factor scaling. 2) add `for:` clauses and playbook commands in every alert. 3) add region SLO panel with burn-rate visualization. 4) wire infra-bot to annotate planned replacements so SLO calc ignores them.
infra-bot: noted: will add annotation endpoint /api/ops/annotations and accept `?type=planned_replacement&node=`.
oncall-sre: test plan before rollout: 1) run dashboard in read-only for 48h 2) create shadow alerts (noops) for 7 days 3) then enable automated drain for one non-critical region for 2 weeks 4) review false positive rate < 2% then ramp.
ben: ack — schedule the run in maintenance window next Tue. :thumbsup:
shawn: LGTM on scoring math once you post the final promql. happy to pair on the burn-rate SLO chart.
maria: thanks all — i'll post updated draft by EOD and tag oncall for the shadow period start. :sparkles:
